modalities.evidence: fMRI data of naturalistic basketball watching
fMRI data of naturalistic basketball watching
subjects recall the end of three basketball games

output.population: 20 subjects watching the last 5 minutes of 9 NCAA games from the 2012 men's tournament; healthy control participants.
output.summary: fMRI from subjects watching the closing minutes of NCAA basketball games and later recalling them, collected to study behavioral, physiological, and neural correlates of surprise during naturalistic viewing.
